name: HSQ 16% Spin Coating 400 nm
body:
Spin coat: 
- No spreading step 
- 3000 rpm with 3000 acceleration
- Spin coat for 60 sec
- 0 rpm in 5 seconds

Bake:
- Temperature: 100 °C
- Time: 3 min

Discharge:
- Cool down for 1 min
- Dispense Discharge H2O (make sure there is no bubble and cover the entire chip)
- No spreading step
- 3000 rpm with 5000 acceleration
- 0 rpm in 5 sec

Results:
- 100 nm after coating and 85 nm after baking

history.note: Duplicated from HSQ Spin Coating 100 nm v1
